in_arabic.name: Maktoomah
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني The Hidden One
in_arabic.long_meaning: Maktoomah هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. From the Arabic root 'kutumah' which means 'to be hidden, concealed'. This name is given to a child who is considered a blessing from God, as her existence was unknown until her birth.

in_urdu.name: Maktoomah
